# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change clearly and directly.

## What problem does this solve?

Explain what was missing, wrong, unclear, outdated, or incomplete.

## Type of change

Mark any that apply:

- [ ] correction
- [ ] clarification
- [ ] structural improvement
- [ ] new section
- [ ] workflow/process improvement
- [ ] governance improvement
- [ ] tooling-specific guidance
- [ ] SEO / discoverability / publishing improvement
- [ ] other

## Scope

Mark any that apply:

- [ ] tool-agnostic
- [ ] vendor-specific
- [ ] repo governance
- [ ] development workflow
- [ ] agent rules
- [ ] multi-agent coordination
- [ ] safety / environment control
- [ ] QA / review
- [ ] website / publishing

## Notes for review

Add anything important for the maintainer to know.

## Upstream-first

If this PR is based on improvements developed elsewhere, please note that here.

Bible is free to use and reuse. If you improve it, please contribute improvements upstream where practical so the main public version can continue improving for everyone.

## Checklist

- [ ] My change is clear and reasonably scoped
- [ ] I kept the wording practical rather than vague
- [ ] I checked for consistency with the rest of the project
- [ ] I am submitting this contribution under the repository license
- [ ] My change does not imply endorsement of any fork, vendor, or derivative
